SECTION 1: The provisions of Sections 38 and 39 of Law No. 2004/004 of
21 April 2004 to lay down the organization and functioning of the
Constitutional Council, as amended and supplemented by Law No. 2012/015
of 21 December 2012, are amended and supplemented as follows:
"CHAPTER V
VACANCY OF THE OFFICE OF PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC
SECTION 38 (new): (1) ln the event of resignation, the President of the
m
Republic shall tender his resignation to the President of the Constitutional
Council and to the Vice-President of the Republic.
(2) ln accordance with Arcticle 6(5) of the Constitution,
the Constitutional Council shall ascertain the permanent incapacity of the
President of the Republic. .
c
(3) The Vice-President of the Republic shall refer the
matter to the Constitutional Council to that effect.
r
(4) Thep Constitutional Council shall rule on the case of
permanent incapacity by a 2/3 (two-thirds) majority of its members.
.
SECTION 39 (nevv}: Pursuant to Section 38 above, the Constitutional
w
Council's ruling to ascertain the permanent incapacity of the President of the
Republic shall be published according to the procedure of urgency and
inserted in the Official Gazette in English and French."
